name: Code For 1
description: Jon fought bravely to rescue the wildlings who were attacked by the white-walkers at Hardhome. On his arrival, Sam tells him that he wants to go to Oldtown to train at the Citadel to become a maester, so he can return and take the deceased Aemon's place as maester of Castle Black. Jon agrees to Sam's proposal and Sam sets off his journey to the Citadel. However becoming a trainee at the Citadel is not a cakewalk and hence the maesters at the Citadel gave Sam a problem to test his eligibility. Initially Sam has a list with a single element n . Then he has to perform certain operations on this list. In each operation Sam must remove any element x , such that x > 1 , from the list and insert at the same position , , sequentially. He must continue with these operations until all the elements in the list are either 0 or 1 . Now the masters want the total number of 1 s in the range l to r ( 1 -indexed). Sam wants to become a maester but unfortunately he cannot solve this problem. Can you help Sam to pass the eligibility test?
input_specification: The first line contains three integers n , l , r ( 0 ≤ n < 2 50 , 0 ≤ r - l ≤ 10 5 , r ≥ 1 , l ≥ 1 ) – initial element and the range l to r . It is guaranteed that r is not greater than the length of the final list.
output_specification: Output the total number of 1 s in the range l to r in the final sequence.
approach_summary: Apply Divide and Conquer paradigm under the Basics framework. Exploit problem invariants to reduce state space and achieve optimal complexity.
